descriptor_rule: character: sign of the bond energy sum 2*sum c_i c_j H_ij over central-ligand pairs (central topology) or all inter-atomic pairs (otherwise), averaged over the degenerate set; |x|<=1e-6 eV is nonbonding. dominant_fragment: central if the central-atom weight averaged over the degenerate set exceeds 0.5, else ligand; ligand_only when there is no central atom.
